description: Start a session on a computer. Give needs (Cerver picks the best fit), or a provider, or a compute_id. A new cloud computer takes about 30 seconds the first time. Returns a session_id for run, move_session and stop_session.

needs.description: What the work needs. Any of: desktop (true for a screen/browser), gpu (true or a name like A100), gpu_memory_gb, ram_gb, cpu_cores, disk_gb, os (macos|linux), arch, tools (e.g. ["ffmpeg","docker"]), online.

provider.description: e2b | vercel | daytona | modal | boat | cloudflare

task.description: One line on what this session is for.

name: start_computer
